text.tspan: Physical · Social engineering · OSINT · Adversary emulation
Access tested the way an adversary would take it.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace
'JetBrains Mono', monospace

text.tspan: Red team operator with field experience across physical, human and technical attack surfaces.
I plan and run adversary-emulation engagements, lead small operator cells, and turn findings
into reporting defenders can act on. Self-taught, and currently going deeper into low-level
work: C, x86-64 assembly and reverse engineering, with a focus on malware analysis.
